claims.statement: The US Jones Act waiver renewal first announced 13 November became effective 16 November, preserving case-by-case voyage approval and not automatically authorising every foreign vessel.
Reuters reported Brent $95.32 and WTI $88.29 at 11:14 GMT on 16 November while IEA expected a Q4 global surplus of 1.7 million bpd; neither price nor forecast confirms safe tanker transit.
Iranian Revolutionary Guards claimed tankers hit mines and caught fire on 15-16 November, but Reuters explicitly could not independently verify these statements.
China's refinery throughput in October 2026 reportedly declined 2% month-on-month and 8.1% year-on-year; it is not a newly observed physical refinery shutdown on 16 November.
IEA's future emergency stock release schedule, including diesel volumes as described by Reuters, is not the same as delivered diesel or a completed release on 16 November.
